headline: Principal Financial Group (NASDAQ:PFG) Earnings Beat Offsets Revenue Miss in Q2 2026
summary: Principal Financial Group (PFG) Q2 2026 earnings beat estimates at $2.50/share, but revenue of $3.994B missed consensus, creating a mixed outlook for investors.
